name: cortico-world-reading-cards
description: 读书小卡：把一起读过、讲过的东西一句一句存成小卡，按出处归拢成一本能翻的 markdown。纯文件、不联网、不调模型。
author: qiqi-cortico

zh.description: 把一起读过、讲过的东西一句一句存成小卡，按出处归拢成一本 markdown。六个工具：card_add / card_list / card_search / card_book / card_answer / card_void；数据是 worlds/reading-cards/data/cards.jsonl 里的纯 JSON 行。

en.description: Save what we read and talked through as one-line cards, grouped by source into a markdown book. Tools: card_add / card_list / card_search / card_book / card_answer / card_void; data lives in worlds/reading-cards/data/cards.jsonl.
